svg.title: The Song or the Self? A preregistered search for personal musical emotion in scalp EEG. Verdict: 0 of 3 hypotheses supported.

div.p: A preregistered search for personal musical emotion in scalp EEG
div.div: Aditya Koundinya · Independent researcher, Bengaluru · October 2026

figure.aria-label: Two illustrative EEG style traces: a strong rhythmic trace for the song and a flat noisy trace for the self

section.p: The short version. Twenty people heard the same twenty songs. When a song moved one listener more than it moved them usually, or more than it moved everyone else, their alpha rhythm showed no detectable change. The song is easy to find in the ratings. The self is much harder to find in the brain.
